estimated_credits.formula: Policy placeholder (D20): min = 1 credit per platform-provider Agent, max = 5 credits per platform-provider Agent; Agents on custom providers consume no Shera credits. The providers slice (S23) replaces this with real pricing.
estimated_credits.settlement_note: The runtime reserves a bounded estimate before execution, settles against actual usage, and releases unused reservations (D20). The preview itself consumes nothing.

approval_requirements.mapping_note: The pinned pack references tools without risk classes (the runtime owns tool definitions, D38); this preview applies the documented D35 default ladder to tool ids, and the runtime re-derives every class at execution time. Read-only tools execute automatically; the other ladder classes request approval (D35).
